scene_1.visual_plan: The scene starts with a medium shot of the model looking directly at the camera while seated in a car, conveying a relatable driving atmosphere. As she begins to speak, the camera cuts to a close-up of the Ottocast Play2Video Ultra in her right hand, clearly showcasing its features. Following this, the camera returns to a medium shot of the model, who remains engaged and enthusiastic while discussing her car experiences. The background remains softly blurred to keep the focus on her expressions. As she mentions the enjoyment of using the product, a smooth cut transitions to a POV shot of the product positioned near her face, allowing viewers to see her genuine excitement and connection to the device.
scene_1.dialogue: 正直言うと、車の純正CarPlayでは物足りなくて、もっと楽しみたいと思っていたんです。でも何を試してもうまくいかなくて諦めかけていたときに、偶然見つけたのがOttocast Play2Video Ultraでした。
